title: bug: thread login tests fail with USBFLASH=1
description: When compiling with USBFLASH=1, test_concurrent_login_same_slot and test_concurrent_login_logout_interleave in wp11_test_pkcs11_threads.c fail with rv=258 (CKR_USER_PIN_NOT_INITIALIZED). The soft token C_Login fails because the flash backend changes login behavior -- the test doesn't call setenv(WOLFP11_SOFT_KEYSTORE_PATH) and the flash backend changes how the soft token initializes its PIN state. Needs investigation of how USBFLASH=1 changes soft token login behavior, and whether the thread tests need a setenv call to disable keystore-backed login.
